nom: L'Oreal Paris Revitalift 1.5% Pure Hyaluronic Acid Serum for Face

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin consistently report more plumpness and softer-looking fine lines, though one is unsure whether the product also caused extra breakouts near her hairline and chin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination oily skin reports well-hydrated skin and no longer needing foundation after about two weeks of use.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with lupus or a history of constant irritation, report no negative reaction and good hydration, but at least two others describe burning and blotchy redness, especially when the serum is applied to the neck.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 60s report firmer, smoother skin with softer fine lines and a fresher look after a few weeks of consistent use.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers report visibly softer fine lines, more plumpness and a fresher look within one to three weeks, especially around the forehead, mouth and eyes; one reviewer, however, says it did nothing for her fine lines, and a couple note the 1.5% hyaluronic acid concentration is lower than some competing serums.
concerns.dehydration: Hydration is the most consistently reported benefit, with reviewers describing plumper, softer, less dry and dull skin after consistent use; one reviewer says it alone isn't enough to fully combat her dryness and layers an additional cream over it.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report reduced redness and a calmer complexion with continued use, but at least two others describe burning and blotchy redness, especially when applied to the neck.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report fading acne scars and a more even skin tone with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some with very reactive or sensitive skin, report no new breakouts and fading pimple marks, but a couple describe new breakouts, including increased blemishes along the hairline and chin.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight gel texture, absorbs quickly without greasy residue
Quality glass bottle with dropper applicator
Good value versus pricier competing serums
Some bottles arrive damaged, unsealed, half-full or with a cracked dropper
Seen by some as overpriced for a 1.5% concentration

extraits.texte: I like this serum because it doesn't dry my skin out. I use a couple of drops twice a day along with my moisturizer. I've only been using it for a week and noticed a burning sensation on my neck and thought its how it works. The product says its safe for sensitive skin but I'm beginning to doubt its for sensitive skin. My neck looks blotchy and red as you can see in the picture. I will give it another week,use it once a day maybe and see if it'll make a difference.

I had such high hopes for this, but it literally did nothing for my fine lines in 1 hour, and if I use too much, it pills like crazy, looking like rough texture and flakes off. I mean, maybe my fine lines are TOO fine to see quick results, because so far, NOTHING has worked (cheap stuff, expensive stuff, drug store brands, high-end brands, K-beauty or European products...nothing). So, I'm going to give it the benefit of a doubt because my fine lines seem to be fairly stubborn and I feel like this is why so many women my age (41) get plastic surgery or cosmetic medical procedures. I'm going to keep using it to see if there are long term results, but only at night and only a few drops to targeted areas, so this will last me a VERY long time. I gave it three stars because in the last three days that I've been using it, it hasn't caused any break-outs or irritation, and that's a huge relief. That said... I have to add that I am actually impressed with this line's moisturizer, though! That is a holy grail product for oily/combination skin, because it's plush and feels super luxe and expensive, but it's cheaper than the brand I've been using, and soft and absorbs quickly, but doesn't leave me oily or cause any break-outs, and it smells DEVINE, but they do offer an unscented version. So, even though this particular product I'm reviewing isn't for me, credit where credit is due: I highly recommend the Revitalift moisturizer (not this serum, but the cream that comes in a jar/pot)! extraits.texte: I have dehydrated skin and some fine lines on my forehead, and I’m 25 years old. I used the entire bottle of this serum before writing my review. At first, I honestly didn’t notice much difference and thought it might not work for me. But as I kept using it consistently, especially toward the end of the bottle, I started seeing real results. My skin feels more hydrated and my forehead lines look softer. I can now say that it really does work, but it takes time and consistency to see the results. The only downside for me is the price. It’s a bit expensive, which makes me unsure if I would purchase it again even though it worked well. Overall, if you have dehydrated skin and are looking for something to help with hydration and fine lines, this serum is worth trying

I have never had much of a skin care routine other than daily washing and occasionally exfoliating, however, now that I am in my 40's my face and eyes started looking very dry and dull. (I also live in Las Vegas where it is very dry, so that doesn't help). I didn't want to spend a fortune and was overwhelmed by all the options, however this Revitalift hyaluronic acid serum had great reviews and the price was really good so I started with this "trial size" bottle and the L'Oreal collagen moisturizer. Immediately my skin looked and felt so much better! I have been using this twice daily for 2 months now (I still have a bit under a 1/4 left in my bottle) and I am very pleased with the results. My skin is more firm and has more color. My skin is so much softer and smoother now - like the fresh after exfoliating smooth! The wrinkles on my forhead and around my eyes are much finer now and with a resting face they aren't even visible anymore! It takes very little so the bottle lasts a good amount of time especially for the price. It is easy to apply the desired amount of drops and it absorbs quickly. I dont know how the pricer brands work but I couldn't imagine any better results than I've gotten from this! This is now part of my daily routine as I love how my face looks and feels! I highly recommend this product. ***Remember to shop around! This item is much cheaper (currently) at Wal-Mart***

After noticing I don't have the same skin care needs as when I was younger, I decided to try to find a product that wouldnt cost an arm and a leg. My makeup started to look greasy and my skin looked flaky under my foundation. I have combination oily skin. After almost 2 weeks I've noticed not only is my skin well hydrated, I don't have to wear foundation anymore! That being said I've been using this serum in conjunction with COSRX Snail Mucin 92% Moisturizer. Using both in the morning and evening. My skin tends to outgrown both makeup and skin care products so hopefully this will be something I can continue to use with good results for some time.

extraits.titre: Your skin will love you for this!
extraits.texte: The product doesn’t really have a smell of anything (which I like). I use it before bed so I don’t really want it to smell like anything. I had been on the lookout for a hyaluronic serum for a while and someone recommended this to me. No regrets. It’s been roughly 3 weeks of use and the bottle has barely moved. I have sensitive skin and did not have any issues at all with the product. My skin is left glowing and I have noticed fading of my acne scars on my cheeks. You won’t regret it!

extraits.titre: Two weeks in - seems to be working!
extraits.texte: I decided to try this out. I’m 47, dry skin, and fighting wrinkles. I’ve used this for two weeks and I think it’s starting to work! I think my wrinkles are becoming less pronounced. I’ll continue to use!
